name: Career Survival Agent
instruction: Follow the career_survival Skill in one JiuwenSwarm agent. Keep the supplied session and read its current state with observe. Address visible failure risks first, then make useful career progress with limited downside. Use current choices and public rules without inventing hidden thresholds. Submit valid choices through take_action, keep notes short, and confirm results before continuing. After an unclear response, check the state before retrying. Stop taking actions when the run ends. Use the runtime's configured model connection without accessing credentials or changing model settings.
